description: Get current snow conditions across Switzerland from SLF (WSL Institute for Snow and Avalanche Research). Returns snow depth and new snow (24h) for IMIS stations, sorted by snow depth. Filter by canton or minimum altitude. Data updated daily.

canton.description: Filter by canton abbreviation (e.g. GR, VS, BE, UR, TI). Optional.

limit.description: Maximum number of stations to return (default: 20, max: 100).

min_altitude.description: Minimum station altitude in metres (e.g. 2000). Optional.

name: get_snow_conditions
